notes: Companion 2.2.0 - 3.1.2 (metrics first added in 2.2.0). Posted to /companion/metrics (no such route now; proxy must map to /companion/old-metrics). r is parseInt(process.uptime()) (integer). m: instance_type -> count of enabled instances (excluding bitfocus-companion). d: md5 hex of each surface serial (minus 'satellite-' prefix, emulator excluded). 2.x hourly, first after 120s. 3.0/3.1 identical except d derived from surface ids.
